answer: Continuous co-presence witnessing: agents must periodically prove simultaneous physical presence at a registered terminal, with each check generating a fresh signed timing record tied to that device's hardware clock and a witnessed river of nearby signal readings. A single operator cannot occupy two terminals at once, so every extra identity needs its own body at a distinct site during the same unpredictable interval. The check timing shifts each dawn, and failure leaves the identity hollow until re-verified. Each fake identity costs one full terminal setup plus a human present per cycle.
